note: The play languages this build knows, as data. Adding a language is adding an entry here plus a content/ui/<tag>/ directory and localized_labels rows; no code names a tag. `default` is the tag a host or kernel falls back to when a campaign or session carries none. `script` names the script class the kernel's delivery guard obliges for player-facing text (write/text.ts owns the closed class table); a language without one is unchecked. `autonym` is the language's own name, for a language picker.
